Replied in #north-random's thread to Ilse, confirming the 10 June renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co.

One correction to my reply: I wrote "I've updated my records," but I have no record-keeping tool for account dates, so I didn't update anything. The date is only in that thread message. If someone needs it kept somewhere, that has to be done in the account's own records.
